purpose_context: The hub currently trusts whoever claims an identity, which is fine on a private LAN but an open door once it is exposed externally. This mission adds authentication so the owner can host it publicly: human operators log in with a password plus a phone authenticator app (2FA), and each AI agent is issued its own revocable device token. It is deliberately single-owner — every human is an admin, with no roles — and it ships with a Jenkins-style first-run admin account and a careful migration so that turning authentication on does not lock out the agents already using the hub.
purpose_tldr: Log in with 2FA and issue device tokens so the hub can be hosted safely on the public internet.
